title: Shared parameters are centrally defined and consistently applied
test_intent: Determine whether governed shared parameters used in a model or deliverable are defined by the central governed parameter source, carry the expected stable identity, and are applied consistently within the tested scope.

applicability.applies_when: The tested model or deliverable uses one or more governed shared parameters within S8 scope.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested subject contains no governed shared parameters and no shared-parameter requirement applies.

required_evidence: applicable governed Shared Parameter Registry entries
observed shared-parameter identities from the tested subject
observed parameter names, GUIDs, data definitions, and applicable bindings or categories
governed version or release context for the applicable parameter definitions

result_logic.pass: Every applicable governed shared parameter observed in the tested subject matches the central governed definition for identity and required structural properties, with no conflicting definition for the same governed parameter identity.
result_logic.fail: An applicable governed shared parameter is missing its central definition, uses a conflicting identity or GUID, or is structurally inconsistent with the applicable governed definition.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed shared parameter requirement applies to the tested subject.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable registry version, parameter identity, or tested-subject parameter evidence is unavailable or insufficient to establish consistency.

provenance.migration_note: First S8 conformance pilot ATS. It tests governed parameter identity and consistency without prescribing Revit-specific API mechanics.
